title: Oracle reachability and machine configuration codes
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with a finite state set and Boolean work-tape alphabet, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $r,K$ be natural numbers. If $2^{(2W+2)(r+\mathrm{logSpace}(|x|)+1)}\le K$, where $W=3(|\mathrm{State}(N)|+1)+3k+1$ and $k$ is the number of work tapes of $N$, then a number $v$ is reachable from some $u<K$ accepted by the initial-configuration oracle, through a finite chain of step-oracle transitions whose targets are all less than $K$, if and only if $v$ is reachable from the code of the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$ by a finite chain of valid one-step configuration codes, with each configuration confined to work-tape positions of absolute value at most $r$.
hypotheses_covered: finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, with $k$ work tapes
